boundaries: A low similarity score is not proof of novelty or security.
Similarity thresholds and search corpus must be pinned; unseen public items remain possible.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One candidate screening pass against a dated comparison corpus.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Case Similarity Assessment meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It flags both obvious duplicates and rewritten versions of the same puzzle for human review.

boundary_conditions: A low similarity score is not proof of novelty or security.
Similarity thresholds and search corpus must be pinned; unseen public items remain possible.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Case Similarity Assessment is a versioned comparison of a Case Candidate with selected bank and known-public items on surface wording, scenario structure, underlying mechanism, answer leakage and exposure evidence, recording method, thresholds and reviewer resolution.
